<title level="1" right="Trait">[Catalyst](/Traits.aspx?ID=791)</title>

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 216

Items with the catalyst trait are consumables that alter or magnify specific spells. Using a catalyst adds the [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645) trait to the spell.
